We need to propose a retrosynthesis route with at least 6 reactions, using templates in order: ['20810', '2895', '1914397', '1914398', '1914399', '74054'].

We have applied template 20810 to target, got two products: product1 = "CC(C)(C)OC(=O)N1CCN(c2cc(N)cc3c2OC2(CCC2)CC3)CC1" and product2 = "O=S(=O)(Cl)c1ccccc1F". So first reaction splits target into those two fragments.

Now we need to apply template 2895 to one of these fragments (presumably the one that matches). We checked that 2895 matches the first fragment (the big heterocycle). So we can apply template 2895 to that fragment to get its precursors. Let's apply.
